goal: Pin historical 2026-10-25 baseline receipt and setup clean test environment
action: Pinned refresh-report.json (199.51s total, 126.76s player-details, 3390 players, 332220 badges). Generated source_baseline.json. Configured run.yml with actual model Gemini 2.5 Pro (execution).

goal: Implement low-overhead profiling and isolate exact performance bottlenecks
action: Created performance_trace.py (< 4us overhead). Profiled full player-details fixture (332,220 badge rows). Isolated bottleneck to Python row-by-row _insert (76.1s out of 86.5s offline duration, 67% of live duration) and uncoalesced Win32 ReadProcessMemory calls (101,700 calls).

goal: Implement safe batching _insert_batch in engine.py and benchmark against baseline with failure injection
action: Implemented _insert_batch with pre-validated column whitelist and type checks. Executed 3-repeat A/B benchmark on fresh isolated DB copies across 332,220 badge rows. Baseline median: 86.81s vs Safe Batching median: 69.48s (1.25x speedup, 17.33s saved per ingestion). Verified failure injection rollback for FK violation, unapproved column, and type mismatch.

goal: Implement public interval coalescing and session caching without reading restricted player bytes
action: Implemented coalesced_projection_ranges() and coalesced_skill_projection_ranges() in player_detail_reader.py and player_skill_reader.py. Coalesced intervals from 15 to 3 per player (<= 764 bytes, 80% syscall reduction). Verified zero intersection with RESTRICTED_PLAYER_RANGES ((785,786), (880,882), (930,931), (1089,1090)). Verified session cache bound to (pid, creation_filetime, save_id, season_year, roster_count). Performed live read-only verification on PID 5720 in 2.065s.

goal: Verify strict relational and content data equivalence across all tables and pass full test suite
action: Executed comprehensive source_equivalence_check.py comparing 332,220 badge rows and all tables. Verified row counts, schemas, and content SHA256 hashes match 100%. Executed full 303-test suite in pytest. All passed cleanly.
